## About
Clifford's Certified Car Care is a locally owned shop in Humble, looking after family, business and personal vehicles for neighbors in Humble, Atascocita and the surrounding areas. Clifford is the owner and a master mechanic, and Roy runs the service desk with Anthony as assistant service manager.
We work on virtually all makes and models, domestic and import, and our technicians are ASE certified and trained on BMW, Mercedes and other European cars. We offer warranties on our work and honor all extended warranties.
A reviewer on our site said Roy lets them know what the repair will be and how long it will take. If something comes up during an inspection, we let you know and help you decide what to do.

## Services
- Oil change and alignment: Routine maintenance to keep your car running right. One reviewer came in for an oil change and alignment and said the price was great.
- Brake repair: Brake work for any make or model, with honest quotes and prompt service.
- Tune-up services: We inspect your vehicle, make sure it is running as it should, and tell you right away if we find a problem.
- From a quick repair to a new transmission: Whatever the job, we have the know-how to do it right.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. We are closed Sunday.

Q: Do you speak Spanish?
A: Yes. Our team speaks fluent Spanish.

Q: Can I book an appointment online?
A: Yes. One reviewer booked online and received follow-up messages confirming the appointment.
